long_biography.plain_text:
De Oliveira helped turn Thrutainers’ established freight-consolidation base into a broader supply-chain network. A major step was Intermodal Cargo Solutions’ move to a larger Durban warehouse. Added handling equipment, trucks and a digital management system increased its ability to store and distribute varied goods. A corresponding Cape Town facility extended the model.

The operating platform traces back to a carrier established in 1978 by H.M. de Oliveira and T.L. Richards. Andre and Gabriel de Oliveira succeeded them in 2003, continuing the company’s intergenerational control while widening its reach. Today, Thrutainers links sea-freight grouping with customs-franchised cargo stations, on-carriage and regional delivery. De Oliveira’s role is therefore both family stewardship and active expansion.
